decision: The contemporary WCVP source-native recipient-alien species co-listing 10/12 is not a trait-free ocean current causation test: reverse-direction taxon co-listing was 11/12, only two positive directions had >=3 appropriate source-specific geo/richness-matched NOAA-model nonapproach controls, and both controls matched co-listed positive rates.
limits: The full 200km original release selection was used to define the original 12 positives; a stricter <=50km launch source has only 10 current-positive directions. Distinct populations should never be silently combined.
The matched nonapproach source pairs are not true natural drift-negative or noncolonized islands.
Controls on plant origin co-recording do not adjust for habitat, introduction history, species colonization dates, coastal ocean velocity and native richness of recipients.
Only two positive directions retained enough (3+) matched controls; no model or p values were fitted.
An ocean current 2005 approach in a 1degree decimated 15m fluid field has no measured viable propagule transport or butterfly establishment.
